inventory.source: OpenCellID-derived planning records; not operator verified

field_semantics.cell_id: OpenCellID source cell column carried into the planning feature (normalized by pack tooling if duplicate/invalid); it is cell-level identity, not PCI, site ID, or tower ID
field_semantics.source_cell_id: preserved only when pack normalization changes a source ID; absent from all 451 active features

method.priority_1: Exact PLMN + observed source Cell ID; no exact matches found.
method.priority_2: Existing authoritative source mapping; none exists for these observations.
method.priority_3: Unique PCI + channel composite; inventory has neither PCI nor EARFCN, so not available.
method.geographic_candidates: Not used; no canonical observation geometry and the existing pack is planning-grade.

all_registered_flag_identity_reconciliat.identity_status_note: Cell snapshots are not confirmed serving measurements; unresolved counts describe the registered-flag candidate pool only.

blocking_reason: No trustworthy canonical serving observations can be constructed from the source status conflict, and no observed identity exactly matches the planning pack source identity fields. No strongest, nearest, or residual-based selection was performed.
